needs_human.note: clearFile (useSelectedFile.ts:55-62) and the folder-row press that calls it (TwoPaneLayout.tsx:68-69) leave ?highlight= in the URL with no file selected; run 4 in decisions.md recorded this as /drive/alpha/notes?highlight=<phrase>. I found no user-visible effect: RightPaneFile reads it only with a file selected, selectFile deletes it because the file id differs (null !== id), and card links rebuild the query. The same applies to section, page and t, and predates this fix.; Carried over from r1 and unchanged: a citation phrase with no match in the note's body, or found only in its frontmatter, scrolls the container to its start (useHighlightPassage.ts:94-98). This puts the frontmatter table above the visible area; decisions.md measured scrollTop 153. The F1 fix removes the stale-phrase route to this behaviour, so it now needs a citation whose phrase does not match the cited note.; Carried over from r1 and unchanged: highlightSpent is set when Read is left even if no highlight was present, and it resets only per mount (Editor.tsx:1274-1284). A first ?highlight= arriving on an already mounted note after Read was left is ignored. The only producer found goes through a separate page, so I found no normal-use route to it.

A note opened with a phrase that has no match scrolls its container to the top (frontend/src/hooks/useHighlightPassage.ts:94-98). decisions.md records scrollTop 153 with the frontmatter table above the visible area and does not say this was chosen. docs/specs/citation-quote-anchor.md has no text on this case in a keyword search. This was raised in r1; the commits since then do not change it. It is no longer reached by selecting another file, only by opening a URL that carries a phrase with no match.; clearFile keeps highlight in the URL (frontend/src/hooks/useSelectedFile.ts:58-59), so pressing the folder row leaves /drive/<path>?highlight=<phrase>, as decisions.md run 4 records. The next selectFile drops it because the absent file param differs from the new id (line 43), so no later note is marked. The only remaining effect is a stale parameter in the address bar, plus any other page or link that copies the query string, which I did not trace.; Selecting the same file keeps the phrase by design (useSelectedFile.test.tsx:78), so the mark stays when the current file is pressed again; decisions.md run 4 records no repeated scroll in that case.
